name: Reset password
annotation: Warm-light token-based reset-password command surface: validate the deep-link token, capture a new password with live requirement and match checks, gate the CTA on real state only, and hand off to Sign in [04]. No dark glass, no fabricated metrics, token value never rendered.
trustControls: Token status names only valid, expired, invalid, or missing — raw token value never renders or logs
ChipProvenance "typed live" for local password-strength rules
BtnPrimary "Reset password" stays disabled (40% opacity) until all 5 requirements pass and confirm matches
Offline: fields stay editable, submit disabled with OfflineBanner
No consent checkbox, export, revoke, or delete claims on this unauthenticated reset route

modules.build: iOS status bar: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, ink-900 icons on warm-light shell (white bg + peach blush corner radial atmosphere). Fixed 44px, no copy.
Rounded back-arrow control, top-left, 44px target, ink-800 icon. Centered wordmark "Balencia" (Overline weight). Transparent over warm-light shell, no divider line.

H1 left-aligned: "Set a new *password*" (italic on password, Newsreader Medium Italic). Subtitle: "Choose something strong and unique." Beneath: token-status chip, ChipProvenance "server token" + check icon, valid-token state only.

GlassPillInput, placeholder "new password", leading lock glyph, trailing eye-toggle icon (masked/unmasked swap, no layout shift). White fill, warm-gray 1px border, 16px radius, focus border orange #FF5E00.

GlassPillInput, placeholder "confirm password", leading lock glyph, trailing eye-toggle, same styling as password field. Match status: border/check turns green (--glow-done) only once both fields are non-empty and equal.

Orange strength rule line "Password strength: Strong" (typed-live state only, ChipProvenance "typed live"). Below: PasswordRequirementList, 5 rows exact copy: "8+ characters", "uppercase letter", "lowercase letter", "number", "special character" — icon + label, crossfade unmet-to-met 160ms.

BtnPrimary full-width, label "Reset password", orange fill #FF5E00. Disabled (40% opacity, non-interactive) until all 5 requirements pass and passwords match. On submit: width locks, spinner replaces label, success crossfades to check badge.

BtnGhost link "Back to sign in" centered below CTA. PrivacyFooter (NEW) caption below: "This link is single-use and expires soon for your security." with inline "Privacy policy" link, muted ink-500. HomeIndicator anchors screen base.

notes: Success state (route stays same, terminal): Figma alias "Congratulations" — orange scalloped check badge with --glow-done, CTA relabels to "Back to log in" (distinct from default footer's "Back to sign in" ghost link); reuse auth congratulations/check badge language only, no new claims. Error/expired state replaces the form region with the token-validation message plus BtnPrimary "Request new link" (per Final Composition's "expired: request new link" line); expired warning fades in without bounce (no alarm). Rate-limit state: server retry-after countdown when present, else generic paused copy, else hidden — never fabricated. OTP-based reset is a separate variant owned by [03b]; this route is strictly token-link based — do not merge OTP UI in. Fonts: Hanken Grotesk (UI) + Newsreader Medium Italic (emphasis word) per session waiver W-FONT-01, standing in for Neue Montreal/Tiempos until available in Figma. Reduced-motion: checklist crossfades, eye-toggle swap, and success glow become instant state changes.
